title: Owen Start
body:
Owen: Hello There! <<Intro>> 
Owen: I haven't seen you around here before, are you new?
[[Yes|Introduction]]
[[No|IntroSkip]]

title: Introduction
body:
You: Yes
Owen: Ah! Then allow me to introduce myself.
Owen: I am the mayor of this town, Owen. It is my job to look after the people here.
Owen: Currently the sections of this town to the east and west have been blocked off due to renovations, so the only accessible buildings are here, and the one to the south.

title: IntroSkip
body:
You: No
Owen: My mistake, I'll let you get going then.

title: TieGuy Start
body:
Mr Tie: Welcome to town!
Mr Tie: You should go talk to the mayor, he's waiting near the storage building to the north.

title: Q Start
body:
Owen: You're back? I have a favor to ask of you then.
Owen: Would you mind helping me look for my monocle, I seem to have lost it and I can't do my work without it.
[[I'd be glad to help|QuestAccept]]
[[Sorry, I'm busy|QuestDecline]]

title: QuestAccept
body:
You:I'd be glad to help
Owen: Thank you so much, I think I lost it in the storage building above us, but we can't get in without the key.
Owen: The key to the storage room should be in my house to the south, here's my house key so you can go in! <<set $QuestStatus to "Accepted">>

title: QuestDecline
body:
<<if $QuestStatus == "Declined">>
You: I don't have the time
<<else>> 
You: Sorry, I'm busy.
<<endif>> 
Owen: That's alright, I'll try to find it myself. <<set $QuestStatus to "Declined">>

title: ReQuest
body:
Owen: I know you said you were busy, but I could really use your help.
[[Sure, I suppose I can hear you out|QuestAccept]]
[[I don't have the time|QuestDecline]]

title: Gratitude
body: Owen: Thanks for helping me out

title: TieGuy_PreQuest
body:
Mr Tie: So, you've met the mayor.
Mr Tie: He seems to have forgotten his monocle today, most likely left it in his house.
Mr Tie: He'll probably come looking for it soon, but something seems off about the monocle...
Mr Tie: When he wears it he seems like a different person, I wanna find out why.
[[TieGuyAltQuest]]

title: TieGuyAltQuest
body:
Mr Tie: I have the tools to get you into his house, however I cannot enter myself.
Mr Tie: I can let you in if you promise to give me the monocle so I can investigate it.
<<if $QuestStatus == "Accepted">>
You: Actually, Owen gave me a key to his house
Mr Tie: Really? He must trust you then
You: He also said that his monocle was in the storage house... not his house.
Mr Tie: He must've dropped it last night when counting the supplies
Mr Tie: Either way, will you help me or not
[[I'm not betraying the mayor's trust.|TieGuyDeclinedQuest]]
[[Sure, why not.|TieGuyAcceptedQuest]]
<<elseif $QuestStatus == "Declined">>
[[I don't have time for this either|TieGuyDeclinedQuest]]
[[I'd be grateful if you could let me in|TieGuyAcceptedQuest]]
<<else>>
[[That would be stealing|TieGuyDeclinedQuest]]
[[I'm down for a little bit of mischief|TieGuyAcceptedQuest]]
<<endif>>

title: TieGuyDeclinedQuest
body:
<<if $QuestStatus == "Accepted">>
You: I'm not betraying the mayor's trust.
<<elseif $QuestStatus == "Declined">>
You: I don't have time for this either
<<else>>
You: That would be stealing
<<endif>>

Mr Tie: I hope, for both of our sakes, that you change your mind
<<set $TieQuest to "Declined">>

title: TieGuyAcceptedQuest
body:
<<if $QuestStatus == "Accepted">>
You: Sure, why not
<<elseif $QuestStatus == "Declined">>
You: I'd be grateful if you could let me in
<<UnlockMayorHouse>>
<<else>>
You: I'm down for a little bit of mischief
<<UnlockMayorHouse>> 
<<endif>>

Mr Tie: Thanks for your cooperation
<<set $TieQuest to "Accepted">>

title: TieGuyPostQuest
body:
<<if $QuestStatus == "Accepted">>
Mr Tie: Looks like you had a good time talking to the mayor?
Mr Tie: But I wouldn't trust him, if I were you. Something seems off with him, especially relating to that monocle of his.
Mr Tie: I wanna investigate it, but I can't do it alone
<<else>>
Mr Tie: Looks like you gave the mayor the cold shoulder, don't wanna help him out?
Mr Tie: I respect it, though I hope you'll be able to help me instead.
Mr Tie: I don't trust the mayor either, especially regarding that monocle of his, he turns into a different person when wearing it, I swear
<<endif>>
[[TieGuyAltQuest]]

title: TieGuyHurry
body:
<<if $QuestStatus == "Accepted">>
Mr Tie: Hurry up and find that key
Mr Tie: Even if Owen trusts you, he'll get suspicious if you take too long
<<else>>
Mr Tie: Hurry up and find the monocle, before Owen gets back
<<endif>>

title: TieGuyReQuest
body:
Mr Tie: Come on, surely you can tell something suspicious is happening too
Mr Tie: You can trust me
<<if $QuestStatus == "Accepted">> 
[[I told you, I won't betray the mayor|TieGuyDeclinedReQuest]]
[[Fine, I'll trust you. I better not regret this |TieGuyAcceptedReQuest]]
<<elseif $QuestStatus == "Declined">>
[[I told you, I don't have the time |TieGuyDeclinedReQuest]]
[[Fine, I suppose I can spare some time to get you the monocle |TieGuyAcceptedReQuest]]
<<else>>
[[I told you, I'm not stealing |TieGuyDeclinedReQuest]]
[[I still don't feel good about this, but I'll trust you |TieGuyAcceptedReQuest]]
<<endif>>

title: TieGuyDeclinedReQuest
body:
<<if $QuestStatus == "Accepted">> 
You: I told you, I won't betray the mayor
<<elseif $QuestStatus == "Declined">>
You: I told you, I don't have the time
<<else>>
You: I told you, I'm not stealing
<<endif>>
Mr Tie: I hope, for both of our sakes, that you change your mind
<<set $TieQuest to "Declined">>

title: TieGuyAcceptedReQuest
body:
<<if $QuestStatus == "Accepted">>
You: Fine, I'll trust you. I better not regret this
<<elseif $QuestStatus == "Declined">>
You: Fine, I suppose I can spare some time to get you the monocle
<<UnlockMayorHouse>>
<<else>>
You: I still don't feel good about this, but I'll trust you 
<<UnlockMayorHouse>>
<<endif>>
Mr Tie: Thanks for your cooperation
<<set $TieQuest to "Accepted">>

title: DoorLock_Storage
body:
*The door appears locked
<<if $hasStorageKey>>
*You have the key, would you like to unlock the door?
[[Yes|UnlockStorage]]
[[No|DeclineUnlock]]
<<endif>>

title: UnlockStorage
body:
<<UnlockStorage>>
*You unlock the door

title: DeclineUnlock
body: *You decide to not unlock the door

title: DoorLock_Mayor
body:
*The door appears locked
<<if $hasMayorKey>>
*You have the key, would you like to unlock the door?
[[Yes|UnlockOwen]]
[[No|DeclineUnlock]]
<<endif>>

title: UnlockOwen
body:
<<UnlockMayorHouse>>
*You unlock the door

title: PostStorageKey_Owen
body:
<<if $QuestStatus == "Accepted">>
Owen: Oh good! You found the key, now you just have to open the storage building and retrieve my monocle.
<<else>>
Owen: That's the key to the storage room...
Owen: How did you find that? It was in my house.
[[A guy wearing a tie let me in |Confess]]
[[I just found this key on the grass outside |Lie]]
<<endif>>

title: Confess
body:
You: A guy wearing a tie let me in
You: He said he was suspicious of your monocle and wanted to investigate it
Owen: You believed that? Clearly he's just trying to rob me.
Owen: Anyway, I need that monocle to do my work, so could you go grab it for me.

title: Lie
body:
You: I'm not sure what you mean, I just found this key on the grass outside
Owen: ...
Owen: I'm not sure why you're lying to me, but since you're going in there anyway can you grab my monocle?

title: PostStorageKey_NoTieQuest_MrTie
body:
Mr Tie: Owen let you into his house to find his monocle, I'm surprised
Mr Tie: Though it doesn't look like you found it...
Mr Tie: I bet he told you where it was, if you could give it to me instead of him so I can investigate it, that would be appreciated.
Mr Tie: I think something is... off about it

title: PostStorageKey_AcceptedTieQuest_MrTie
body:
<<if $QuestStatus == "Accepted">>
Mr Tie: You found the key?
Mr Tie: Nice!
Mr Tie: Now all you need to do is grab the monocle from the storage building
<<else>>
Mr Tie: You couldn't find the monocle?
Mr Tie: But it looks like you found something else
You: Yeah, it looks like the key to the storage building
Mr Tie: It's possible that the Mayor left his monocle in there checking stock last night, you should check.
Mr Tie: Let me know if you find it, and remember
Mr Tie: Don't let the Mayor know about this
<<endif>>

title: PostStorageKey_DeclinedTieQuest_MrTie
body:
Mr Tie: Back so soon?
Mr Tie: Did you find what you were looking for
[[Yep |explain]]
[[Still looking |dismiss]]

title: explain
body:
You: Yep! I found the key
You: About to go get the monocle from the storage building
Mr Tie: This probably won't convince you, but please, when you find the monocle don't give it to the Mayor

title: dismiss
body:
You: No, I couldn't find it
Mr Tie: ...
You: I'm serious
Mr Tie: Sure, just make sure if you ever do find the monocle, don't give it to the Mayor

title: PostMonocle_Owen
body:
<<if $QuestStatus == "Accepted">>
Owen: You found it? Great! Now i can get on with my work for today
<<else>>
Owen: You found my monocle then?
Owen: You better give it to me, I need to get on with my work
Owen: Oh, and if i catch you sneaking around again...
Owen: There'll be consequences
<<endif>>
[[*Give Owen the Monocle |OwenMonocle]]
[[*Keep the monocle |KeepMonocle_Owen]]

title: OwenMonocle
body:
Owen:Thanks!
<<OwenMonocleSprite>>
Owen: I've been waiting all day for this
You: Wait... why do you have a mustache now
Owen: Don't worry about it
<<OwenMonocleEnding>>
Owen: Im saying nothing

title: KeepMonocle_Owen
body:
Owen: I'm not going to use force to get it off you
Owen: BUT...
Owen: Make sure you give it to me

title: PostMonocle_MrTie
body:
Mr Tie: You have the Monocle!
Mr Tie: Quick, give it to me I'll finally be able to investigate it
[[*Give Mr Tie the Monocle |MrTieMonocle]]
[[*Keep the monocle |KeepMonocle_MrTie]]

title: MrTieMonocle
body:
Mr Tie: I appreciate this
<<TieMonocleSprite>>
Mr Tie: I'll finally be able to understand the power of this monocle
You: Nothing seems different
Mr Tie: No, I can tell. This monocle is giving me strength 
<<TieMonocleEnding>>
Filler Text

title: KeepMonocle_MrTie
body: Mr Tie: Fine, but make sure you don't give it to the Mayor
